evals.cmd.usage:
Usage:
  chatcli eval run [suite.yaml|dir] [--provider P --model M] [--judge-provider P --judge-model M]
                   [--trials N] [--concurrency N] [--filter id,tag:x] [--timeout D] [--max-cost USD]
                   [--out report.json] [--markdown report.md] [--baseline report.json]
                   [--max-regressions N] [--tolerance F] [--min-pass-rate F] [--with-memory] [--keep] [--json] [--quiet]
  chatcli eval list [suite.yaml|dir] [--filter ...]
  chatcli eval validate [suite.yaml|dir]
  chatcli eval compare <baseline.json> <current.json> [--max-regressions N] [--tolerance F] [--json]

The suite path defaults to ./evals. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 pass rate below --min-pass-rate, 2 usage or invalid suite, 3 regression against --baseline.
evals.flag.baseline: previous report to compare against (exit 3 on regression)
evals.flag.bin: chatcli binary that runs the cases (default: this one)
evals.flag.filter: comma-separated case ids (globs allowed) or tag:<name>
evals.flag.keep: keep each trial's sandbox for inspection
evals.flag.markdown: write a Markdown report to this file
evals.flag.max_cost: stop starting trials once spend reaches this many USD (0 = no cap)
evals.flag.max_regressions: case regressions tolerated against the baseline
evals.flag.min_pass_rate: minimum pass rate, 0 to 1 (exit 1 below it)
evals.flag.out: write the JSON report to this file
evals.flag.tolerance: pass-rate drop tolerated against the baseline, 0 to 1
evals.flag.with_memory: evaluate with your real memory and recall (the run may also write to your memory)
